title: the first thing your agents need is a control plane
subject: the first thing your agents need is a control plane
summary: no matter what coding agent you use, it gets more useful when authority, proof, and human return queues are explicit.
dek: a practical note from building admin.anipotts.com as a read-only operator dashboard first, then a content review surface, then a guarded write path.
audience: builders running coding agents across real repos, live sites, and operational state

hook.body: no matter what coding agent you use, the first useful thing to build around it is a control plane: a place for authority, proof, and the few decisions that come back to you.

sections.heading: safe lanes versus hard gates
sections.body: start with the contract. some work is safe to finish end to end: inspect, edit, verify, commit, push, and open a draft PR. other work is gated because it touches live systems, secrets, auth, DNS, publishing, outbound sends, or irreversible state. the contract makes the next allowed move obvious.
sections.thread_beat: the useful split is allowed operations versus gated operations.

sections.label: proof beats trust
sections.body: a finished agent task should leave proof that another agent can inspect: changed files, exact checks, commits, PRs, deploy evidence when deploys are authorized, and explicit blockers when they are not. trust is too vague for a shared repo. proof is portable.
sections.thread_beat: proof lets the next agent continue the work without inheriting chat memory as a source of truth.

sections.heading: NEEDS-ANI as a human syscall queue
sections.body: the human return path should be small. NEEDS-ANI has one job: agents ask for the few decisions only Ani can make, including approval, choice, secret setup, account-side action, identity, payment, or final taste.
sections.thread_beat: a good human queue is narrow enough to answer from a phone.

sections.heading: admin as the control plane
items: content inventory and preview states next
guarded write paths only after authority exists
live gates visible before any live control exists
sections.body: admin.anipotts.com should make state legible before it makes state mutable. content, fleet state, handoffs, approvals, and proof belong in one surface because agents need to know what they are allowed to do next.
sections.thread_beat: the control plane maps intent to authority to operation to proof to state.

close.body: the future looks like a system where agents know what they are allowed to do next, what proof they owe, and when the right move is to return one clear decision to Ani.
close.cta: draft only. review for tone, claims, and source refs before any archive or send path.
